title: NEXT-GENERATION CYBERATTACK DETECTION WITH LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS: ANOMALY ANALYSIS ACROSS HETEROGENEOUS LOGS

bias_targets.methodology: Systematically varying the proportion of anomalous (attack) and normal samples in test sets from 0% to 100% to evaluate how severe class imbalance causes models to internalize a degenerate learning strategy, resulting in catastrophic class collapse and exclusive prediction of the majority class.

Evaluating the effect of a two-phase training strategy by first pretraining on a dataset with natural operational distributions (~2% attack prevalence) to prevent premature bias toward the anomaly detection task, followed by fine-tuning on a balanced dataset (35% attack prevalence).
